AVIATION — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

2. When learning Introduction to Simulated Flying, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Simulated Flying.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. When learning Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.

5. When learning Aviation Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

8. When learning Aircraft Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Systems.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Systems.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Systems.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Systems.

9. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

11. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

12. When learning Aviation Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

17. In three clear sentences, explain Aviation Security and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
